<!-- scarp-cli-release: v0.0.7-alpha.2 -->
<!-- scarp-current-source: 638dc4c227f34f1c660be66834bcc0cbdb22dec8 -->

~~~scarp
bind count: integer = 7;
var total: integer = count;
total += 5;
bind label: string = "Scarp";
bind ready: boolean = total == 12;
bind ratio: float = to_float(total) / 5.0;
print(label, ready, total, ratio);
~~~

~~~text
Scarp true 12 2.4
~~~

~~~scarp
bind big: bigint = bigint("999999999999999999999");
print(big + bigint_from_integer(1));
bind exact: decimal = 0.1d + 0.2d;
print(exact);
print(0.1 + 0.2);
~~~

~~~text
1000000000000000000000
0.3
0.30000000000000004
~~~

~~~scarp
var pair: tuple<integer, string> = (7, "draft");
bind saved = pair;
pair[0] = 9;
bind values: array<integer, 2> = [array: 10, 20];
bind changed = array_set(values, 1, 40);
print(saved[0], pair[0]);
print(values[1], changed[1]);
~~~

~~~text
7 9
20 40
~~~

~~~scarp
bind empty: list<integer> = [list: <integer>];
bind items = list_push(empty, 5);
bind next = list_push(items, 8);
print(list_len(items), list_len(next), next[1]);
bind counts: map<string, integer> = [map: "z": 2, "a": 1];
bind updated = map_set(counts, "a", 9);
print(map_get_or(counts, "a", 0), map_get_or(updated, "a", 0));
print(map_get_or(updated, "absent", -1));
~~~

~~~text
1 2 8
1 9
-1
~~~

~~~scarp
record Book { title: string, available: boolean }
variant Search { Missing, Found(record Book) }

pure funcra describe(outcome: variant Search) -> string {
    match on outcome {
        case Missing { return "Not found"; }
        case Found(book) { return book->title; }
    }
}

bind book: record Book = new Book { title: "Scarp", available: true };
print(book->available);
print(describe(new Search::Found(book)));
print(describe(new Search::Missing()));
~~~

~~~text
true
Scarp
Not found
~~~

~~~scarp
pure funcra add_one(value: integer) -> integer {
    return value + 1;
}

}
~~~

docs/guide/native-abi.md:
<!-- scarp-cli-release: v0.0.7-alpha.2 -->
<!-- scarp-current-source: 638dc4c227f34f1c660be66834bcc0cbdb22dec8 -->

~~~c
#include <assert.h>
#include <stdint.h>

struct scarp_result {
    int64_t value;
    uint32_t status;
    uint32_t span_id;
};

extern struct scarp_result scarp_bounded_integer_entry(int64_t value);

int main(void) {
    struct scarp_result ok = scarp_bounded_integer_entry(41);
    assert(ok.value == 42 && ok.status == 0 && ok.span_id == 0);
    struct scarp_result bad = scarp_bounded_integer_entry(INT64_MAX);
    assert(bad.value == 0 && bad.status == 1);
    struct scarp_result again = scarp_bounded_integer_entry(-1);
    assert(again.value == 0 && again.status == 0);
    return 0;
}
~~~

~~~sh
cc -std=c11 -Wall -Wextra -Werror host.c calls.o -o host-check
./host-check
~~~
docs/guide/native-layout.md:
<!-- scarp-cli-release: v0.0.7-alpha.2 -->
<!-- scarp-current-source: 638dc4c227f34f1c660be66834bcc0cbdb22dec8 -->

~~~rust
use scarp::native_object::{plan_x86_64_value_layout, NativeLayoutShape};

fn main() -> Result<(), Box<dyn std::error::Error>> {
    let program = scarp::compile("bind pair = (true, 42);")?;
    let id = program.binding_type_ids()[0];
    let layout = plan_x86_64_value_layout(program.type_registry(), id)?;
    assert_eq!((layout.size, layout.alignment), (16, 8));
    assert_eq!(layout.shape, NativeLayoutShape::Fields {
        offsets: vec![0, 8],
    });
    Ok(())
}
~~~
